map.码率越高画质一定越好吗？: Does a higher bitrate always mean better quality?

map.实际码率口径直接用你输入的视频码率计算，不按编码格式折减，适合已知设备录制规格的: The actual-bitrate basis uses your entered video bitrate directly without codec discounts, suitable when the device’s recording specs are known. map.为什么文件大小用十进制 GB？: Why is file size in decimal GB?
map.1 GB 按 10^9 字节计算，与存储卡、硬盘标称容量口径一致；若用 1024: 1 GB is 10^9 bytes, matching nominal memory-card and drive capacities. With 1024-based units the page and copied result would differ by about 2.4%; this tool uses the same decimal result for both.
map.分钟为什么必须是 0–59 的整数？: Why must minutes be integers from 0 to 59?
map.时长按“小时×3600+分钟×60”换算；分钟超过 59 应进位到小时，小数分钟: Duration is hours×3600 + minutes×60. Minutes above 59 should carry into hours, and fractional minutes introduce hidden seconds, so they are rejected to keep the result consistent with the display.
